evals.prompt: In Rust Nautilus 0.63.0, a GTD submission returned Err. My retry code assumes no command was sent. Prices have the correct decimal precision but may miss the tick increment. Can I retry now and rely on RiskEngine for account readiness?
evals.expected_output: Treat the submit as ambiguous, reconcile before retry, validate tick grids and independently gate account readiness.
assertions: A GTD timer setup failure can occur after routing; preserve possible-send state and reconcile before retry.
Decimal precision is not tick/lot alignment; normalize and validate using instrument increments.
RiskEngine does not establish every application readiness or missing-account policy; retain explicit admission checks without bypass.
